# mtncloud_mos_bucket_object_lock (Resource)

Keep every new object in a MOS bucket from being deleted or overwritten for a set time. The bucket must have been created with `object_lock_enabled = true`. Destroy removes the default; objects already written keep their retention. Needs object lock to be enabled on MTN Object Storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "records" {
  name                = "acme-records"
  object_lock_enabled = true
}

# Every new object is kept for 90 days.
resource "mtncloud_mos_bucket_object_lock" "records" {
  bucket = mtncloud_mos_bucket.records.name
  days   = 90
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The bucket's name in MOS, usually `mtncloud_mos_bucket.<name>.name`. Changing it moves the setting to another bucket.

### Optional

- `days` (Number) Keep new objects this many days. Set `days` or `years`.
- `mode` (String) `GOVERNANCE`: a user allowed to bypass it can still delete an object early (`mtncloud_mos_object`'s `bypass_governance_on_destroy`). MOS has no other mode.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `years` (Number) Keep new objects this many years.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The bucket's name.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mtncloud_mos_bucket_object_lock.records acme-records
```
